sourceReviewNotes: All 12 paper pages, all 20 scheme pages and all 27 generated source figures visually read.
104 separately practicable tasks; 39/39 census leaves covered. Raw ask scan: 95 lines, with one passage-attribution exemption retained in full context.

Both Q5(j) branches, both Q10 alternatives and all five Q12 options retained. Complete laser/spectrometer methods each retain 15 marks; the apparatus and measurement pairs retain their individual 3-mark slots.

The official Q12(c) Doppler formula denominators are reversed beside the extrema. A visible correction explains approaching c−u and receding c+u, retaining the exact official image and its correct numerical answers, independently recalculated.
Narrow source-reader repairs preserve the full square-root radicand and isotope superscript/subscript ordering; 21 reviewed generators reproduce and four mathematical regressions pass.
The Q4 graph pointer refers to the graph the candidate must draw, not a missing printed illustration.
